title: One closed integer trajectory forces C_max(25781, 10^6+1) below theta.
statement: The 6/5 cheap/expensive valley multiset of the run-type extremizer at (L,o)=(25781,16266) is not jointly realizable on one closed integer CycleMin orbit at n=10^6+1, so the max finance C_max over globally joined valley itineraries is strictly less than theta.
counterexamples: C_max_ub(25781, 10^6+1) equals budget_rhs ≈ 5.89e-4 > theta ≈ 2.55e-5; the optimistic remainder restores Theorem 4.7
Bounded B&B at n=10^6+1 dies at empty_ooe / cyclemin / shared_ooe_prefix after at most one circuit (24 nodes, 15 starts, not capped)
Reading C_max_partial < theta as a kill rewrites follow depth; 365 (four OOE) and 1000057 (two OOE) still have C_used+C_remain >= theta
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / global orbit-budget coupling
notes: Phase 0 only. Unparked the named Section 5 program for one bounded B&B. gap_kind=archived_cell. No K<=20 proof, no inverse-width reopen, no CUDA, no floor raise, no L=55293. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: Small-e oracle e<=4 on odds 11..79; calibration {365, 1000057}; bounded B&B at (25781, 10^6+1), node cap 20000
